# ex: selector expression with type mismatch (different struct types)
ex {
	var t T1
	t.X -> t.Y
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T1 struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

type T2 struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func F(a T1, b T2) int {
	return a.X + b.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -11,5 +11,5 @@
 }

 func F(a T1, b T2) int {
-	return a.X + b.X
+	return a.Y + b.X
 }
